title: AMR Genomic Surveillance & Resistance Intelligence
advanced_native_capabilities: genotype–phenotype concordance metrics; drug-level performance; discordance review; MIC/breakpoint intake; outbreak-cluster screening; isolate-level evidence gate
confirmatory_requirements: pinned AMR database; species confirmation; phenotypic AST; breakpoint standard/version; independent isolate cohort; public-health expert review
release_boundary: Genomic AMR predictions remain research support and never replace phenotypic susceptibility testing or public-health interpretation.

title: Protein–Ligand Co-Design
advanced_native_capabilities: multi-objective consensus ranking; rank-stability uncertainty; selectivity panel; structure/ligand completeness; applicability-domain gate; candidate evidence gate
confirmatory_requirements: prepared receptor and ligand states; versioned design/docking weights; orthogonal docking/MD; selectivity panel; measured affinity; medicinal chemistry review
release_boundary: Computational co-design prioritises experiments; it does not establish binding, selectivity, efficacy, safety or synthesizability.

title: Long-Read Epigenome, Methylation & Imprinting
advanced_native_capabilities: coverage-aware methylation intervals; replicate-aware DMR gate; haplotype imbalance; imprinting concordance; batch/model drift review; region-level evidence gate
confirmatory_requirements: reference genome/build; basecaller/modification model release; phasing evidence; biological replicates; orthogonal methylation assay; epigenomics expert review
release_boundary: Methylation, allele-specific and imprinting findings require model, coverage, phasing, replication and orthogonal confirmation.
